Password Input

Password Input provides a secure password field with show/hide toggle, strength indicator, and password requirements checklist.

Basic Password

Password input with lock icon and show/hide toggle.

HTML
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">🔒</span>
  <input type="password" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter password">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft zak-btn-icon" onclick="togglePassword('id', this)">
    👁
  </button>
</div>

Show/Hide Toggle

Interactive toggle that switches between password and text type.

JavaScript
function togglePassword(inputId, btn) {
  const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
  const eyeIcon = btn.querySelector('.zak-icon-eye');
  const eyeOffIcon = btn.querySelector('.zak-icon-eye-off');
  if (input.type === 'password') {
    input.type = 'text';
    eyeIcon.style.display = 'none';
    eyeOffIcon.style.display = 'block';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Hide password');
  } else {
    input.type = 'password';
    eyeIcon.style.display = 'block';
    eyeOffIcon.style.display = 'none';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show password');
  }
}

Password Strength Indicator

Visual indicator showing password strength level.

JavaScript
function updateStrength(password) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('pw-strength-bar');
  const fill = document.getElementById('pw-strength-fill');
  const text = document.getElementById('pw-strength-text');
  if (!password) { bar.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  bar.style.display = 'block';
  let score = 0;
  if (password.length >= 8) score++;
  if (password.length >= 12) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  const levels = [
    { width: '20%', color: '#ef4444', label: 'Very Weak' },
    { width: '40%', color: '#f97316', label: 'Weak' },
    { width: '60%', color: '#eab308', label: 'Fair' },
    { width: '80%', color: '#22c55e', label: 'Strong' },
    { width: '100%', color: '#16a34a', label: 'Very Strong' }
  ];
  const level = levels[Math.min(score, 4)];
  fill.style.width = level.width;
  fill.style.backgroundColor = level.color;
  text.textContent = 'Strength: ' + level.label;
}

Password Requirements

Checklist showing which requirements are met.

  • At least 8 characters
  • At least one uppercase letter
  • At least one number
  • At least one special character
JavaScript
function checkRequirements(password) {
  const checks = [
    { id: 'pw-req-1', test: password.length >= 8 },
    { id: 'pw-req-2', test: /[A-Z]/.test(password) },
    { id: 'pw-req-3', test: /[0-9]/.test(password) },
    { id: 'pw-req-4', test: /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password) }
  ];
  checks.forEach(check => {
    const el = document.getElementById(check.id);
    el.classList.toggle('zak-password-requirement-met', check.test);
  });
}

JS Toggle Demo

JavaScript
function togglePassword(inputId, btn) {
  var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
  var eyeIcon = btn.querySelector('.zak-icon-eye');
  var eyeOffIcon = btn.querySelector('.zak-icon-eye-off');
  if (input.type === 'password') {
    input.type = 'text';
    if (eyeIcon) eyeIcon.style.display = 'none';
    if (eyeOffIcon) eyeOffIcon.style.display = 'block';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Hide password');
  } else {
    input.type = 'password';
    if (eyeIcon) eyeIcon.style.display = 'block';
    if (eyeOffIcon) eyeOffIcon.style.display = 'none';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show password');
  }
}

ClassDescription

Accessibility

  • The show/hide toggle must have aria-label ("Show password" / "Hide password").
  • Use aria-describedby to link strength indicators and requirements to the input.
  • Never auto-submit the form when toggling password visibility.
  • Announce strength changes with aria-live="polite".
  • Ensure the toggle button is keyboard accessible (Tab + Enter/Space).
